market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $140 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI front-month is near $96 on April 27, 2026, with geopolitical premium from stalled US-Iran negotiations and Strait of Hormuz tensions. Reaching $140 settlement requires a ~46% rise in about 2 months. Even with escalation risk, full Hormuz closure pricing typically peaks $110-$130. Settlement (not intraday) bar is harder than candle high.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether Iran/Hormuz crisis fully escalates into open conflict before end of June.
